verses.en: Behold, I say unto you, that as my servant Martin Harris has desired a witness at my hand, that you, my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., have got the plates of which you have testified and borne record that you have received of me;
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, ona ua manao la’u auauna o Matini Harisi i se molimau mai lo’u lima, e faapea ua ia te oe, o la’u auauna, o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, papatusi na e molimau ma tautino atu na e maua mai ia te a’u;

verses.en: And now, behold, this shall you say unto him—he who spake unto you, said unto you: I, the Lord, am God, and have given these things unto you, my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., and have commanded you that you should stand as a witness of these things;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, o le mea lenei ia e fai atu ia te ia— o ia o lē na fetalai mai ia te oe, na fai mai ia te oe: O A’u, o le Alii, o le Atua, ma na Ou tuu atu ia te oe, o la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, nei mea, ma ua Ou poloaiina oe e tatau ona e tulai o se molimau o nei mea;

verses.en: And I have caused you that you should enter into a covenant with me, that you should not show them except to those persons to whom I commanded you; and you have no power over them except I grant it unto you.
verses.sm: Ma sa Ou faia ia e ulu mai i se feagaiga faatasi ma a’u, o le a e lē faaalia atu ia mea vagana ai ia i latou na o tagata o e na Ou poloaiina ai oe; ma ua leai sau pule i luga o ia mea vagana ai ua Ou tuu atu ia te oe.

verses.en: And you have a gift to translate the plates; and this is the first gift that I bestowed upon you; and I have commanded that you should pretend to no other gift until my purpose is fulfilled in this; for I will grant unto you no other gift until it is finished.
verses.sm: Ma ua ia te oe se meaalofa e faaliliu ai papatusi; ma o le meaalofa muamua lenei Ou te faaee atu i ou luga; ma ua Ou poloaiina ia leai se isi meaalofa e tatau ona e manatu i ai seia oo ina faataunuuina lo’u faamoemoe i lenei mea; ona e leai se isi meaalofa Ou te tuu atu ia te oe seia maea.

verses.en: Verily, I say unto you, that woe shall come unto the inhabitants of the earth if they will not hearken unto my words;
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o le a oo mai le ōi i e o nonofo i le lalolagi pe afai latou te lē faalogo mai i a’u upu;

verses.en: For hereafter you shall be ordained and go forth and deliver my words unto the children of men.
verses.sm: Aua a mavae nei o le a faauuina oe ma e alu atu ma avatu a’u upu i le fanauga a tagata.

verses.en: Behold, if they will not believe my words, they would not believe you, my servant Joseph, if it were possible that you should show them all these things which I have committed unto you.
verses.sm: Faauta, afai latou te lē talitonu i a’u upu, o le a latou lē talitonu ia te oe, la’u auauna e, Iosefa, e tusa pe a na mafai ona e faaali atu ia te i latou mea uma ua Ou tuu atu ia te oe.

verses.en: Oh, this unbelieving and stiffnecked generation—mine anger is kindled against them.
verses.sm: E, lenei tupulaga e lē talitonu ma le ua maaa— ua sasao a’e lo’u ita e faasaga ia te i latou.

verses.en: Behold, verily I say unto you, I have reserved those things which I have entrusted unto you, my servant Joseph, for a wise purpose in me, and it shall be made known unto future generations;
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, na Ou faasaoina mea na ua Ou faatuatuaina atu ia te oe, la’u auauna, Iosefa, mo se faamoemoega poto ua ia te a’u, ma o le a faailoa atu i tupulaga o lumanai;

verses.en: But this generation shall have my word through you;
verses.sm: Ae o le tupulaga lenei o le a latou maua la’u upu e ala atu ia te oe;

verses.en: And in addition to your testimony, the testimony of three of my servants, whom I shall call and ordain, unto whom I will show these things, and they shall go forth with my words that are given through you.
verses.sm: Ma e faaopoopo i lau molimau, le molimau a le toatolu o a’u auauna, o e o le a Ou valaaulia ma faauuina, o e o le a Ou faaali atu i ai nei mea, ma o le a latou o atu ma a’u upu e tuu atu e ala atu ia te oe.

verses.en: Yea, they shall know of a surety that these things are true, for from heaven will I declare it unto them.
verses.sm: Ioe, o le a latou iloa ma le mautinoa ua moni nei mea, ona o le a Ou tautinoina atu ia te i latou mai le lagi.

verses.en: I will give them power that they may behold and view these things as they are;
verses.sm: O le a Ou tuu atu ia te i latou le mana e mafai ai ona latou vaai ma tagatagai i nei mea e pei ona i ai;

verses.en: And to none else will I grant this power, to receive this same testimony among this generation, in this the beginning of the rising up and the coming forth of my church out of the wilderness—clear as the moon, and fair as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners.
verses.sm: Ma e leai ni isi i totonu o lenei tupulaga e ese mai ai o le a Ou tuu atu i ai lenei mana, ia mauaina lenei molimau, i le amataga lenei o le fanae ma le oo mai o la’u ekalesia i fafo na i le vao— ua manino e pei o le masina, ma susulu e pei o le la, ma matautia e pei o se autau ua i ai ni tagavai.

verses.en: And the testimony of three witnesses will I send forth of my word.
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou auina atu le mau a molimau e toatolu e uiga i la’u upu.

verses.en: And behold, whosoever believeth on my words, them will I visit with the manifestation of my Spirit; and they shall be born of me, even of water and of the Spirit—
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ai se e talitonu i a’u upu, o i latou ia o le a Ou asiasi atu i ai ma le faaaliga a lo’u Agaga; ma o le a fanauina i latou ia te a’u, i le vai lava ma le Agaga—

verses.en: And you must wait yet a little while, for ye are not yet ordained—
verses.sm: Ma e ao ina outou faatalitali pea laitiiti teisi, ona e lei faauuina outou—

verses.en: And their testimony shall also go forth unto the condemnation of this generation if they harden their hearts against them;
verses.sm: Ma o le a alu atu foi la latou molimau mo le tausalaina o lenei tupulaga pe afai latou te faamaaa o latou loto e faasaga ia te i latou;

verses.en: For a desolating scourge shall go forth among the inhabitants of the earth, and shall continue to be poured out from time to time, if they repent not, until the earth is empty, and the inhabitants thereof are consumed away and utterly destroyed by the brightness of my coming.
verses.sm: Ona o le a oo atu se sasa faatafunaga ia i latou o e o nonofo i le lalolagi, ma o le a faaauau ona sasaa mai lea taimi i lea taimi, pe afai latou te lē salamo, seia oo ina gaogao le lalolagi, ma ua susunuina e ua nonofo ai ma matua faaumatia lava i le pupula o lo’u oo mai.

verses.en: Behold, I tell you these things, even as I also told the people of the destruction of Jerusalem; and my word shall be verified at this time as it hath hitherto been verified.
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te tau atu ia te oe nei mea, e pei lava foi ona sa Ou tau atu i tagata e uiga i le faafanoga o Ierusalema; ma o le a faamaonia la’u ’upu i le taimi nei e pei lava ona sa faamaonia e oo mai i le taimi nei.

verses.en: And now I command you, my servant Joseph, to repent and walk more uprightly before me, and to yield to the persuasions of men no more;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te poloai atu ia te oe, la’u auauna Iosefa, ia e salamo ma savali sao atili i o’u luma, ma ia e lē toe tuu atu i faatauanauga a tagata;

verses.en: And that you be firm in keeping the commandments wherewith I have commanded you; and if you do this, behold I grant unto you eternal life, even if you should be slain.
verses.sm: Ma ia e tumau i le tausiga o poloaiga ua Ou poloaiina ai oe; ma afai e te faia lenei mea, faauta Ou te tuu atu ia te oe le ola e faavavau, e tusa pe fasiotia oe.

verses.en: And now, again, I speak unto you, my servant Joseph, concerning the man that desires the witness—
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, Ou te toe tautala atu ia te oe, la’u auauna Iosefa, e uiga i le tagata o lē ua manao i le molimau—

verses.en: Behold, I say unto him, he exalts himself and does not humble himself sufficiently before me; but if he will bow down before me, and humble himself in mighty prayer and faith, in the sincerity of his heart, then will I grant unto him a view of the things which he desires to see.
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te ia, ua ia faamaualugaina o ia lava ma ua lē lava ona ia faamaualalo o ia lava i o’u luma; ae afai e ifo o ia i lalo i o’u luma, ma faamaualalo o ia lava i le tatalo malosi ma le faatuatua, i le faamaoni o lona loto, ona Ou tuu atu lea ia te ia se vaaiga o mea ua manao o ia e vaai i ai.

verses.en: And then he shall say unto the people of this generation: Behold, I have seen the things which the Lord hath shown unto Joseph Smith, Jun., and I know of a surety that they are true, for I have seen them, for they have been shown unto me by the power of God and not of man.
verses.sm: Ma ona ia fai atu lea i tagata o lenei tupulaga: Faauta, ua Ou vaai i mea na faaali mai e le Alii ia Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma ua Ou iloa ma le mautinoa ua moni i latou, aua ua Ou vaai i ai, ona sa faaali mai i latou ia te a’u i le mana o le Atua a e lē o le tagata.

verses.en: And I the Lord command him, my servant Martin Harris, that he shall say no more unto them concerning these things, except he shall say: I have seen them, and they have been shown unto me by the power of God; and these are the words which he shall say.
verses.sm: Ma o A’u o le Alii Ou te poloai atu ia te ia, la’u auauna lea o Matini Harisi, ia lē toe fai atu e ia ni isi upu ia te i latou e uiga i ia mea, vagana ai le fai atu o ia: Ua Ou vaai i ia mea, ma sa faaali mai i latou ia te a’u i le mana o le Atua; ma o upu ia ia fai atu e ia.

verses.en: But if he deny this he will break the covenant which he has before covenanted with me, and behold, he is condemned.
verses.sm: Ae afai e faafiti e ia lenei mea o le a soli e ia le feagaiga na ia osifeagaiga muamua ai ma a’u, faauta foi, o le a tausalaina o ia.

verses.en: And now, except he humble himself and acknowledge unto me the things that he has done which are wrong, and covenant with me that he will keep my commandments, and exercise faith in me, behold, I say unto him, he shall have no such views, for I will grant unto him no views of the things of which I have spoken.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, vagana ai ua faalotomaualalo e ia o ia lava ma tautau mai ia te a’u mea sese na ia faia, ma osifeagaiga ma a’u o le a ia tausia a’u poloaiga, ma faatino le faatuatua mai ia te a’u, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te ia, o le a lē maua e ia ni vaaiga faapena, ona o le a Ou lē tuuina atu ia te ia ni vaaiga o mea ua Ou tautala atu ai.

verses.en: And if this be the case, I command you, my servant Joseph, that you shall say unto him, that he shall do no more, nor trouble me any more concerning this matter.
verses.sm: Ma afai o le tulaga lea e i ai, Ou te poloai atu ia te oe, la’u auauna Iosefa, ia e fai atu ia te ia, ia lē toe faia e ia se mea, pe toe faalavelave mai ia te a’u e uiga i lenei mataupu.

verses.en: And if this be the case, behold, I say unto thee Joseph, when thou hast translated a few more pages thou shalt stop for a season, even until I command thee again; then thou mayest translate again.
verses.sm: Ma afai o le tulaga lea e i ai, faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te oe Iosefa, a uma ona e faaliliu o ni isi itulau itiiti, ona e taofi lea mo se vaitau, seia oo ina Ou toe poloaiina oe; ona mafai ai lea ona e toe faaliliu.

verses.en: And except thou do this, behold, thou shalt have no more gift, and I will take away the things which I have entrusted with thee.
verses.sm: Ma vagana ai ua e faia lenei mea, faauta, o le a e lē toe mauaina se meaalofa, ma o le a Ou aveese mea na Ou faatuatuaina atu ia te oe.

verses.en: And now, because I foresee the lying in wait to destroy thee, yea, I foresee that if my servant Martin Harris humbleth not himself and receive a witness from my hand, that he will fall into transgression;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ona ua Ou muai iloa le lamalamaga o faatalitali mai e faaumatia oe, ioe, ua Ou muai iloa afai e lē faalotomaualaloina e la’u auauna o Matini Harisi o ia lava ma maua se molimau mai lo’u lima, o le a pa’ū atu o ia i le solitulafono;

verses.en: And there are many that lie in wait to destroy thee from off the face of the earth; and for this cause, that thy days may be prolonged, I have given unto thee these commandments.
verses.sm: Ma e toatele o loo faapupuna faatalitali mai e faaumatia ese oe mai luga o le fogaeleele; ma o le pogai lenei, ina ia mafai ona faalevalevaina o ou aso, ua Ou tuu atu ai ia te oe nei poloaiga.

verses.en: Yea, for this cause I have said: Stop, and stand still until I command thee, and I will provide means whereby thou mayest accomplish the thing which I have commanded thee.
verses.sm: Ioe, o le pogai lenei na Ou fai atu ai: Ia taofi, ma tu lē gaoioi, seia Ou poloaiina oe, ma o le a Ou saunia ala e mafai ai ona e faataunuu o le mea ua Ou poloaiina ai oe.

verses.en: And if thou art faithful in keeping my commandments, thou shalt be lifted up at the last day. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma afai e te faamaoni i le tausiga o a’u poloaiga, o le a siitia a’e oe i luga i le aso gataaga. Amene.
